entries.summary: This durable V1 capability covers the cost portion of an activated ability, including its mana, tap, discard, sacrifice, or other payment.
This durable V1 capability covers sacrificing a permanent as an additional cost to cast a spell.
This durable V1 capability covers a player choice of a creature type from the rules-defined creature-type vocabulary.
This durable V1 capability covers the player explicitly chooses a numeric value for X or pays an X variable as part of a choice or cost.
This durable V1 capability covers discarding a card as an explicit cost before the colon or casting instruction resolves.
This durable V1 capability covers a target selection whose candidate objects are cards in a graveyard.
This durable V1 capability covers paying life as an explicit additional cost to cast a spell or activate an ability.
This durable V1 capability covers a choose-one, choose-one-or-more, or equivalent mode-selection decision.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that selects two or more targets or a variable plurality of targets.
This durable V1 capability covers a target contract selecting multiple cards or objects from graveyards.
This durable V1 capability covers a choice whose candidates come from an open rules vocabulary rather than a finite card-listed set.
This durable V1 capability covers a choice made after or conditional on a destruction event.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that collects multiple choices in a stated sequence.
This durable V1 capability covers an activated cost requiring the player to tap another creature.
This durable V1 capability covers an activated cost requiring the player to tap a chosen subset of creatures or permanents.
This durable V1 capability covers a target card selected from any player's graveyard.
This durable V1 capability covers a targeted instruction that destroys a target permanent or object.
This durable V1 capability covers a targeted effect that modifies a target's power and toughness.
This durable V1 capability covers a target contract restricted by a stated characteristic, zone, type, or controller.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that uses the rules-defined target designation for at least one object, player, or zone.
This durable V1 capability covers a choice that selects exactly two targets.
This durable V1 capability covers the Amass operation that creates or grows a specified Army creature token.
This durable V1 capability covers an attached Aura permanent and its explicit enchant restriction or attachment relation to another object.
This durable V1 capability covers a Curse Aura whose subtype and enchant-player attachment impose an effect on an enchanted player.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that restores control of an object only within its stated boundary or controller set.
This durable V1 capability covers the Convoke keyword that permits tapping creatures to help pay a spell's cost.
This durable V1 capability covers granting an activated ability whose cost or effect is determined by a changing object characteristic.
This durable V1 capability covers the Flash keyword that permits casting the card as though it had instant timing.
This durable V1 capability covers the Flashback permission to cast a card from a graveyard for its flashback cost.
This durable V1 capability covers the Kicker keyword and its optional additional casting cost.
This durable V1 capability covers a triggered ability whose condition is a land entering the battlefield.
This durable V1 capability covers token quantity or token characteristics scaled by a player's life total.
This durable V1 capability covers one event creating multiple tokens, with the plurality established by the card-side instruction.
This durable V1 capability covers a resolution that applies separately to multiple players or actors in a stated sequence.
This durable V1 capability covers the Populate operation that creates a token copy of a creature token you control.
This durable V1 capability covers returning or putting a card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
This durable V1 capability covers token creation whose quantity is determined by X, a count, equal-to relation, or for-each scaling.
This durable V1 capability covers the Scry operation that looks at the top cards of a library and orders them or puts them on the bottom.
This durable V1 capability covers one instruction that sacrifices multiple objects simultaneously as one event.
This durable V1 capability covers the Surveil operation that looks at the top cards and sends each to the graveyard or back on top.
This durable V1 capability covers creation of tokens that explicitly enter the battlefield tapped.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that creates one or more token objects.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that distinguishes nontoken objects from tokens in its eligibility or result.
This durable V1 capability covers a mode or effect that explicitly offers token creation as one alternative and counter placement as another.
This durable V1 capability covers a card-side effect that uses a creature type to constrain a selection, condition, permission, or outcome.
This durable V1 capability covers permission to cast a card from a zone other than its owner's hand.
This durable V1 capability covers the Artifact card type on the public type line.
This durable V1 capability covers an actual triggered ability whose event condition is a creature or permanent attacking.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that adds a color to a permanent or object in addition to its existing colors.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that sets an object's color to black.
This durable V1 capability covers an actual triggered ability whose event is a combat event other than specifically combat damage.
This durable V1 capability covers an exile instruction that applies only when its stated condition or eligibility test is satisfied.
This durable V1 capability covers a continuous effect that grants, removes, or modifies an ability on the affected object.
This durable V1 capability covers a continuous effect that modifies creatures' power and toughness for its stated duration.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect assigning control to an object as it enters or is put onto the battlefield.
This durable V1 capability covers the copiable values of a creature token used to define a created token's characteristics.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that counts tapped permanents or creatures as a numeric input.
This durable V1 capability covers a setup state whose defining progress is established by placing or removing a named counter.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that puts, removes, or tracks counters on a named object.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that counters a target spell.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that deals damage to a player, creature, planeswalker, or other object.
This durable V1 capability covers an actual triggered ability that triggers when a creature or permanent is dealt damage.
This durable V1 capability covers an actual triggered ability whose event is a creature dying or moving from battlefield to graveyard.
This durable V1 capability covers the Deathtouch keyword or an effect that explicitly grants or relies on Deathtouch.
This durable V1 capability covers a delayed triggered ability created now to trigger on a later stated event or time.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that destroys a permanent or other destroyable object.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that moves one or more cards from a library into a player's hand as card draw.
This durable V1 capability covers one effect that combines drawing cards and discarding cards as its operative hand operation.
This durable V1 capability covers an actual triggered ability whose event or result is card draw.
This durable V1 capability covers an actual triggered ability with an end-step event condition.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that moves a card or permanent to the exile zone.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that grants or gives the Flying keyword to a creature or permanent.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that grants an activated ability with a printed cost and colon to another object.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that grants a mana-producing activated ability to a permanent.
This durable V1 capability covers permission to cast a card from a graveyard.
This durable V1 capability covers a numeric effect whose value counts cards or objects in a graveyard.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that returns a card from a graveyard to a player's hand.
This durable V1 capability covers a card-side operation or condition that uses a graveyard as an object zone.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect granting Indestructible through the end of the current turn.
This durable V1 capability covers the Land card type on the public type line.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that inspects or processes multiple cards while moving through a library.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that changes a player's life total by gaining or losing life.
This durable V1 capability covers one effect in which an opponent loses life while that same effect gives life to its controller.
This durable V1 capability covers a linked pair in which an ability returns the cards exiled by its linked ability.
This durable V1 capability covers the loyalty-ability activation restriction and timing applicable to a planeswalker.
This durable V1 capability covers placing, removing, or counting loyalty counters on a planeswalker.
This durable V1 capability covers an activated ability that produces mana and satisfies the rules-defined mana-ability form.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that adds mana to a mana pool or explicitly produces mana.
This durable V1 capability covers a permanent whose printed type line is Basic Land and therefore functions as a basic mana source.
This durable V1 capability covers one effect returning multiple creature cards from multiple graveyards to the battlefield.
This durable V1 capability covers one effect that destroys all or a plurality of permanents or objects.
This durable V1 capability covers one instruction that exiles all or a plurality of objects as a mass operation.
This durable V1 capability covers one effect that processes a plurality of cards while traversing or revealing a library.
This durable V1 capability covers one effect that puts multiple cards or permanents directly onto the battlefield.
This durable V1 capability covers one effect requiring multiple players or multiple permanents to sacrifice in one event.
This durable V1 capability covers one continuous or resolving effect that changes the type of multiple objects as a group.
This durable V1 capability covers one instruction that untaps multiple permanents, such as untap all or a stated set.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that puts cards from a library into a graveyard by the mill operation.
This durable V1 capability covers wording that applies distinctly to each opponent or to a multiplayer set of players.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that selects or orders a card relative to the top or bottom of a library.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect whose result distinguishes an object's owner from its current controller.
This durable V1 capability covers a permission or restriction that explicitly resets or is limited once per turn.
This durable V1 capability covers the Planeswalker card type and its loyalty ability object class.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that puts an object directly onto the battlefield.
This durable V1 capability covers returning or putting a card from a graveyard onto the battlefield.
This durable V1 capability covers reanimation that puts the returned permanent onto the battlefield tapped.
This durable V1 capability covers a prevention or replacement effect that prevents a stated event or amount from occurring.
This durable V1 capability covers a temporary power/toughness modification applied only to a selected subset of objects.
This durable V1 capability covers the source card or permanent exiling itself as an explicit part of its effect.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that shuffles a library or other stated set of cards.
This durable V1 capability covers a resolving spell or ability that shuffles its own card into its owner's library.
This durable V1 capability covers a static continuous effect that modifies the power and toughness of a team of creatures.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that adds Zombie as a subtype to the affected object.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that adds a subtype to an object's existing type line.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect or trigger whose operative event is a permanent becoming tapped.
This durable V1 capability covers one temporary effect granting both Flying and Double Strike for its stated duration.
This durable V1 capability covers a permission effect whose availability is explicitly conditioned on a creature type or tribal identity.
This durable V1 capability covers an actual triggered ability with an event condition introduced by when, whenever, or at.
This durable V1 capability covers permission to cast a card from a graveyard only until the stated turn boundary.
This durable V1 capability covers a permission to cast, activate, or use an object that lasts until end of turn or another stated turn boundary.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect that changes, adds, or removes a card type, subtype, or supertype.
This durable V1 capability covers an actual triggered ability with an upkeep event condition.

entries.notes: Durable shared prerequisite for selected-pair zone-changing capabilities; not a second registry or a selected-pair B2 root.
entries.summary: Durable shared prerequisite for new object incarnations across zone changes.
This durable V1 capability covers an effect whose information boundary jointly depends on library cards and graveyard cards.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that makes a card or object visible to the players as a reveal.
This durable V1 capability covers an instruction that searches a library for a card or object and applies the stated reveal or shuffle result.
